lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical lines visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform with a slight narrowing of gaps toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Y-shaped bifurcations are visible at the dorsal termination of the 4th and 8th stripes (counting from the posterior); stripes merge at the dorsal ridge line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most stripes show significant discontinuity, terminating as dashed segments or isolated spots before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 10 high-contrast spots are clustered on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, distal to the primary vertical stripe terminations.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct horizontal rows of spots align across the mid-thigh, parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white facial chevron between the eyes, two white ocular spots on the cheek, and high-contrast white patches on the lower forelimbs and inner hindlimbs.
